findings.title: Memory-backed emptyDir fills the memory limit
findings.cause: container warm is OOMKilled, and it writes to emptyDir cache at /cache, which has medium Memory: the volume is a tmpfs whose files count against its 32Mi memory limit, and they outlive each restart, so the container is killed again as it starts; Deployment cache has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container warm exited with code 137 (OOMKilled), restarted 6 times
volume cache is an emptyDir with medium Memory (no sizeLimit), mounted by container warm at /cache

findings.fix: Raise warm's memory limit above what it keeps in cache plus its own use, set a sizeLimit on the volume so writes fail with no space instead, or drop medium: Memory to keep the files on the node's disk.
